description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter application. It defines the root widget MyApp, which manages routing based on login state. It references external screens (calculator_screen.dart, login_screen.dart) and a service (app_prefs.dart) to determine initial routing based on user login status.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, manages routing based on user login state, and builds the MaterialApp widget.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes and runs the app by creating an instance of MyApp.

methods.name: MyApp.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp, returning a FutureBuilder that resolves login status and sets the initial route.
